office_does: The prosecuting attorney charges and prosecutes crimes in Superior and District Court and is the county government's lawyer; four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Adam N. Kick, in office for more than 15 years, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skamania County Prosecuting Attorney for more than 15 years, seeking re-election; lists a 'Non Partisan' party preference.
